notes.title: Warlord 0.14.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Warlord 0.14.1 contains the following changes:


[list]
[*] Re-rendered some chapter 13 and chapter 14 animations to fix vertex anomalies and improve water effects
[*] Rebalanced chapter 11 options with Cassandra
[*] New improved soldier fight animations for chapter 3
[/list]

Explanation:
Many of the animations from chapters 13 and 14 had some flickering effect caused by mesh vertexes jumping around.  This seems to be a bug in blender 3.5+ but not in blender 3.4.  in addition, the water ripple effect did not render correctly in many of the animations from those scenes.  Several of those animations have been rerendered to correct the errors.

For the chapter 11 rebalance, if you are on the Pure Lust route, it's possible to get locked-out of Cassandra starting in chapter 11.  The options there have been changed to not lock out her path.

Several of the animations in chapter 3 have been redone to add a cool fire-effect during the soldier fight.

tags.bug: [*] Re-rendered some chapter 13 and chapter 14 animations to fix vertex anomalies and improve water effects

notes.title: Warlord Chapter 7 (0.7.0)
notes.content:
In Warlord Chapter 7, MC and crew travel to Tomorii and MC meets up with Stheno. They try to convince Haphaestus to enchant the relics to use lust and chaos energy.

[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Chapter 7 (~900 lines total)
[*] 8 new animated scenes
[*] 1 new bad ending
[*] 1 new route: lust+chaos
[/list]

Chapter 7 introduces some of the first payoffs to the lust and chaos routes and adds a new route "lust + chaos".  Each route has unique scenes or may cause the MC to miss scenes altogether.  I will be adding a guide shortly that will help you make the choices necessary for each route.

Additionally, Chapter 7 introduces the first extensive bad ending in the game.  Don't worry, after playing the bad end, you'll  be whisked back to make a different choice and continue playing the game.

Please consider reviewing Warlord. it really helps.

tags.feature: Chapter 7 introduces some of the first payoffs to the lust and chaos routes and adds a new route "lust + chaos".
Additionally, Chapter 7 introduces the first extensive bad ending in the game.
